title: Panthera Prime
extract:
The Panthera Prime is the Prime variant of the  Panthera with increased critical chance, status chance, fire rate, and magazine size, at some expense to accuracy, reload speed, and max ammo capacity. The primary fire sawblades gain explosive properties, while still being able to ricochet off surfaces. Panthera Prime was released alongside  Inaros Prime and  Karyst Prime.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage.
Primary fire shoots bouncing miniature saws in full automatic that explode in a 1.6 meter radius on impact with a surface or enemy, consuming 2 ammo per shot.
Initial hit and explosion apply status separately.
Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls.
Explosion has linear damage falloff from 100% to 80% from central impact.
Alternate Fire deploys a single levitating sawblade 8 meters away that deals continuous damage and staggers enemies, only consuming ammo when dealing damage.
Can be deployed without consequence when no targets exist.
Considered as beam, the range can be extended with Beam Length mods like   Sinister Reach.
When modded for Punch Through, each individual targets hit consume additional ammo.
Can use the Panthera-exclusive  Disarming Purity Augment mod.

Acquisition

Vaultings
On July 16th, 2022, Panthera Prime, along with  Inaros Prime and  Karyst Prime, entered the Prime Vault and were retired from the reward tables. Any preexisting components or fully-built items will remain as is.

Trivia
Tied with  Panthera and  Zhuge for the highest base damage of all fully automatic rifles.
Tied with  Attica for the second slowest fire rate of all fully automatic weapons, after  Panthera.
